groups.activity: Mother's bounties, tranq-capture and fishing/mining turn-ins for Entrati Family Tokens

rows.label: turn Family Tokens in to Grandmother
rows.note: Mother tokens 100 each; Father/Daughter/Otak tokens 500; Son tokens 1,000

bonuses: Tier 3-5 non-Steel Path bounties from Mother are the fastest token source; two or three tier-5 runs cover a full daily cap.
Trading mixed tokens to Grandmother for Grandmother tokens pays 1.5x the standing.
Son tokens come from tranq-capturing wildlife with the Tranq Rifle; capturing from Archwing keeps animals from spotting you.

conditions: MR 9 is required to buy the main Keratinos Blueprint; the component blueprints have no such gate, so you can buy and build Blades and Gauntlets earlier.

Buy a third Blade Blueprint if you are still below Entrati Rank 2 Acquaintance — that rank-up consumes one Keratinos Blade Blueprint, and a blueprint already queued in the Foundry can't be used for it.

groups.activity: mine Adramalium and Dagonic veins, then refine at Otak

rows.label: Adramal Alloy
rows.note: 4 Otak crafts: 20 Adramalium + 20 Travoride + 600 Plastids + 15 Lucent Teroglobe each; Blade material

rows.label: Purged Dagonic
rows.note: 2 Otak crafts, 10 mined Dagonic each; Blade material

conditions: Travoride is mined on Orb Vallis, not Deimos; bring it over before starting Adramal Alloy crafts.
Lucent Teroglobe comes from Vitrific Outcrops on the Cambion Drift.

groups.activity: fish Deimos pools and caves; gather Pustulite and Ganglion

rows.label: Pustulite
rows.note: Gravid Blastemas or bounty rewards; Blade material

rows.label: Ferment Bladder
rows.note: cut at Daughter from most Deimos fish; Gauntlet material

rows.label: Waxen Sebum Deposit
rows.note: cut only from Amniophysi, a cave fish in Vome and Fass; Gauntlet material

bonuses: The fish parts and mined gems you cut and mine here also earn Entrati Family Tokens toward the standing above, so this doubles as the currency farm.

rows.label: Blade
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 40 Adramal Alloy, 24 Pustulite, 6 Purged Dagonic, 4 Gallium — build twice

rows.label: Gauntlet
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 20 Ferment Bladder, 16 Ganglion, 6 Waxen Sebum Deposit, 4 Neurodes — build twice
